source_title: Maoists on tax collection drive in Jhapa
spatial_scope: Damak, Bhadrapur, and Mechinagar municipalities, Jhapa district
coding_rationale: Direct dated report that Maoists were collecting local taxes and allocating local-body contracts in three named Jhapa municipalities; this is direct parallel fiscal-administrative activity, not an inference from violence.
second_coder_notes: Scope limited to the three named municipalities.

spatial_scope: Ilam district headquarters and other trade centres, Ilam district
coding_rationale: INSEC reports a weeklong Maoist-imposed blockade in Ilam, with the district headquarters and other trade centres left almost empty; this directly supports an access constraint for 1-7 September.
second_coder_notes: Coded only the explicitly described blockade period; the 8 September fear/rumour effects are not carried into the observable.

spatial_scope: Sharada Higher Secondary School compound, Khanar VDC, Sunsari district
coding_rationale: The dated report states that the school was being used as Maoist army barracks and that 25 cadres were currently based there, directly establishing Maoist presence at the named site.
second_coder_notes: Observation dated to the Kantipur report date (11 October); takeover was reported as occurring on Monday.

source_title: Report of the High Commissioner for Human Rights on the human rights situation and the activities of her Office, including technical cooperation, in Nepal
spatial_scope: Affected RNA personnel/family homes and land in Khotang district; specific localities not stated
coding_rationale: OHCHR reports CPN (Maoist) threats in which RNA members' and families' homes were padlocked/marked and land seized, with such cases reported from Khotang in the last three months of 2005; this directly constrains access/use of property.
second_coder_notes: District-level aggregate report; exact Khotang locality, household, and incident date are not specified.
